published.source: Shaman PR (Lightning Shield on raid damage hits: 2 a minute melee, 1 ranged, 2026-10-15)

summary: The Elemental Level 60 build with 16 Restoration points for Mana Tide Totem, cast at 20% mana for the group's mana. It is 1.1% behind Level 60 at 180 s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4 s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9 s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9 s (lands 0.1 s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9 s
Cooldowns (Blood Fury, Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine) as they come up
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less
Mana Spring Totem when it is down and Mana Tide is not up
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 20 s remain
Flame Shock whenever its DoT is down
Lava Burst on cooldown, unless Flame Shock would run out before the cast ends
Earth Shock once a Lightning Bolt would no longer land before the fight ends
Lightning Shield when it is down (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 1 a minute)
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler (no Chain Lightning on one target)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 37 spell power and 14 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Mana Tide Totem is A/B -1.4 for the shaman itself: a 3 min fight with a potion and rune doesn't need the mana
Water Shield point is inert (nothing hits the caster)
Lightning Bolt X's base damage ×1.12, the raise a beta build gave the top playable rank; the client's 31+ ranks look untuned (rank 10 ~201 base at 0.714 coefficient)
Only the Tier 1 2-piece is live by the standard; the 5-piece (Lava Burst -1 s cooldown) would add more
One 2% crit elixir by the standard; Owl stacked on Sages would be about +10 if Forever allows stacking
Raid damage hits on the shaman (1 a minute, which fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate from boss timers, not measured in logs; the assumptions panel runs 0 and 10
notes: mksettings -spec ele -apl level60_mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself).
